verdict.rationale: Token2's management tools (Companion App, fido2-manage CLI/GUI, browser toolsets) are documented only as conventional GUIs and command-line utilities. Nothing in the evidence shows operating the product through natural-language commands. A management tool could plausibly offer such an interface, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
